where.if: and ( upper(p.product_name) like upper ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') or upper(w.warehouse_name) like upper ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') or upper(p.status) like upper ('%' || #{keyword} || '%') )

mapper.select: select count(*) from stock s join lot_in li on s.lot_in_id = li.lot_in_id join inbound_detail id on li.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id join product p on id.product_id = p.product_id

select * from ( select p.product_name, trunc(li.expiration_date) - trunc(sysdate) as days_left from stock s join lot_in li on s.lot_in_id = li.lot_in_id join inbound_detail id on li.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id join product p on id.product_id = p.product_id where s.quantity > 0 and li.expiration_date >= trunc(sysdate) order by li.expiration_date asc
) where rownum <= 3
